info1: Drink n' Play consist of multiple minigames
info2: In each minigame (except roulette) players will gain points
info3: The player with the most points at the end wins the game
info4: The winner of each minigame will earn a number of DRINKING CREDITS
info5: The DRINKING CREDITS can then be used to fill up your opponents glasses
info6: If your glass is filled, you have to drink up!
info7: Your DRUNKOMETER will track your intoxication level
